statement: Style Builder builds sketchy edge styles from hand-drawn strokes; strokes sets pane assigns stroke sets to edge types.

source.ref: Style Builder: strokes library and sets

superiority: Stroke engine integrated in the main app rather than a separate tool.

acceptance.sketch: Build a style with 5 strokes and two sets; the resulting .style loads and renders with those strokes on the correct edge types.

statement: Import strokes from image folders, existing .style files or a template.
superiority: Imports from vector and raster sources with automatic stroke segmentation.

acceptance.sketch: Import a stroke template with 16 strokes; the style library contains exactly 16 strokes.

statement: Draw your own strokes on the provided template.

source.ref: Drawing strokes for a style library

superiority: In-app stroke drawing with pressure support.

acceptance.sketch: Draw strokes on the supplied template and import; extracted strokes match the drawn bounding boxes within 1 px.

statement: Choose effects, widths and more for strokes.
superiority: Same effects exposed as live edge-style parameters in the Styles panel.

acceptance.sketch: Change width, jitter and extension settings; the rendered edge shows those effects and the setting values persist in the .style file.

statement: Preview the style on a sample model.
superiority: Real-time preview in the actual viewport.

acceptance.sketch: Preview a style on the sample model; the preview image equals the result of applying the same style in the viewport within SSIM 0.98.

superiority: An open, documented, diffable style format with legacy .style import.
